summary: Adial Pharmaceuticals filed an Item 8.01 current report disclosing a further adjournment of its 2026 Annual Meeting with respect to Proposals 3, 4, 5 and 6, which remain pending Nasdaq conditional approval of an Initial Listing Application. The meeting first convened September 17, 2026, was adjourned to October 1 and again to October 15, 2026, and will reconvene October 26, 2026 at the company's Charlottesville offices; the record date remains August 17, 2026. No transaction, price, stake or advisor terms are stated. This is a routine meeting-procedure notice, not a special situation; watch Nasdaq approval timing and proposal outcomes.
